member.name: T:ApexTree.SemanticZoomOptions
member.summary: Semantic zoom (level of detail): swap what each node renders based on how large it appears on screen, so a zoomed-out tree stays readable instead of turning into unreadable full cards.
member.remarks: Requires ApexTree core 2.0.0 or later. Node geometry is fixed across tiers: the layout is computed once and crossing a threshold only changes what is drawn inside each node's box, so nothing moves and the camera is untouched. Thresholds are measured in on-screen pixels of node width, not zoom percentages, so they behave the same at any container size.

member.name: P:ApexTree.SemanticZoomOptions.Enabled

member.name: P:ApexTree.SemanticZoomOptions.CompactBelow
member.summary: Below this apparent node width in pixels, nodes drop from the full card to a compact name-and-role plate. Default: 90.

member.name: P:ApexTree.SemanticZoomOptions.DotBelow
member.summary: Below this apparent node width in pixels, nodes drop again to a colored slab carrying just the name. Default: 42.
